summary: Late nightly firing. With the fuller enumeration (B5) complete, the firing ran the primary-source lift (B16) over 84 medium-confidence records in three waves of research subagents, each followed by independent AI review, and a first slice of the systematic absence checks (B17) over 30 not_started or diverged records, each check re-run in part by an independent reviewer. Stage changes: c18-31 in_progress 30 to proposed 20 (the January 2025 orders direct training reviews and contractor listings, no operative funding bar, parallel match); c24-05 not_started 0 to proposed 5 (S. 1646, introduced 2025-05-07, would report on and time-limit section 13(3) emergency lending); c14-33 not_started 0 to proposed 5 (the NIH Reform Act, S. 664 and H.R. 1497 of February 2025, caps three successor institute directors at two five-year terms, a partial match). Progress moved without a stage change on c21-23 (35 to 40, the ESA harm-definition rescission read in full and in force since 2026-09-14) and c12-18 (35 to 25, the only operative step is the State bureau's elimination while a House-passed bill runs the other way). Court status changed on c27-03 and c28-02 (pending to upheld), c18-06 (upheld to pending) and c14-07 (stayed to dismissed after the plaintiffs' voluntary dismissal of 2026-01-30), and was set or updated on c07-04, c08-01, c14-08, c05-13 and c06-05. Nineteen B16 records moved to high confidence; the 30 B17 records moved from low (30 to 65) to 55 to 65 after documented checks (the Unified Agenda check was partial for every record because reginfo.gov listings cannot be browsed here, so no record reached 70). Four reviewer confidence figures that applied the not_started absence cap to proposed or in_progress records were adjusted by the coordinator with the reviewer's figure recorded as the alternative (c05-17, c11-34, c06-24, c24-05). Counted set unchanged at 627 (in_progress 212, proposed 149, not_started 99). About 105 of 190 searches used. Three validator findings in records not touched by the lift were repaired (court_status date and URL on c12-04 and c19-22; a source listed on c17-22). The GitHub export was prepared and validated, but the push was refused because the repository is not attached to the session, so the branch exists only in the session workspace.
title: Primary-source lift (84 records) and first systematic absence checks (30 records)
